inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Nation State Actors via Microsoft Graph

properties.description:
This rule identifies Microsoft Graph API activity originating from IP addresses flagged as Nation State indicators in Entra Sign-in logs.

It works in two stages:

Collects all IP addresses tagged with the risk event type estsNationStateIP from SigninLogs (last 1 day).

Correlates those IPs with Microsoft Graph Activity Logs (same 90-day window).

Returns the total count of Graph API operations from Nation State–linked IPs.

This detection helps SOC teams uncover nation-state threat actor activity targeting Microsoft Graph (e.g., mailbox access, data exfiltration, or lateral movement attempts
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Nation State Actors via Microsoft Graph
properties.query:
let NationStateIP =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where RiskEventTypes_V2 contains "estsNationStateIP"
    | distinct IPAddress;
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where IPAddress has_any(NationStateIP)
| project TimeGenerated, Location, RequestMethod, ResponseStatusCode, IPAddress, UserAgent, RequestUri, AppId
